pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular sub-polygonal dark brown regions with relatively smooth edge gradients; spatial area of patches is larger on the upper flank and decreases in size towards the posterior and ventral regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored inter-patch spaces with junction nodes forming predominantly tri-radiate and quadri-radiate intersections; thickness is relatively uniform throughout the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dark, bristly 1D contour along the upper neck and back; serration frequency is high but partially obscured by biological occlusions.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: Multiple structural interruptions and discontinuities along the dorsal ridge line caused by the presence of perched birds (oxpeckers).

other_distinctive_markers: High concentration of avian ectoparasite gleaners (oxpeckers) positioned along the dorsal ridge, upper neck, and lower flank.
